The Stop Loss Strategy That Can 10X Your Profits

Most traders never master one of the simplest — and most powerful — ways to manage trades: trailing their stop loss.

In this video, I’ll break down exactly what stop loss trailing is, how it works, and why it’s a key part of building consistency and protecting profits.

You’ll learn how to use trailing stops to:

Create true “win-win” scenarios in your trading

Maximise profits on strong moves, while still protecting your downside

This is one of the most overlooked skills in trading — but once you understand how to use it properly, it can completely change the way you manage your trades.
